ModMetaData.name: RimRound
ModMetaData.author: Niwatori401, RandomDudeFromTheRim
ModMetaData.description:
RimRound is a weight gain mod for RimWorld. Pawns fill up, grow round and have opinions about it.
This community build adds, among much else: - A density-aware liquid-food network (pipes, vats, auto-feeders), feeding others, prisoner fattening - Gluttonium: radiating ore, drugs, serums and a gas diffuser for defending your colony - (Anomaly) A flesh dimension behind a void portal, void echoes, meld bioweapons, the gorge constrictor (a huge leech that pumps its load into whoever it latches onto - bindable, and reshapeable in a vat) and the sweet slime, a non-lethal Melting Love-style stalker - (Ideology) The Feedees meme: a feedee worship ritual and a ritual that calls a void seam - A fattening commission quest (the Empire pays in honor), the void surge weather event, and touch interactions that play out properly - Integrations: SpeakUp, RimVore-2, the Intimacy series, Lactation Expansion, Biological Warfare, Vanilla Nutrient Paste Expanded (and Reimagined Progression), Vanilla Persona Weapons, Vanilla Weapons Expanded - Non-Lethal, Odyssey unique weapons and Unique Weapons Unbound
Requires Harmony, Humanoid Alien Races, Vanilla Expanded Framework and Vanilla Nutrient Paste Expanded. The flesh dimension, constrictor and sweet slime need Anomaly.
